layer: 2 — automated scanning (ZAP baseline + npm audit), plus the mandatory post-deploy smoke
zap_mode: baseline, passive only. -j enables the AJAX spider so a client-routed SPA is actually crawled; it drives a browser and issues no attack payloads. No active scan, no fuzzing, no authentication attack — per the spec's explicit prohibition.
zap_scope: unauthenticated, production origin only. mock-api and Supabase are out of scope.
